scope: CSharp validates every additional parameter through CanPassFunctionArgument; SLG resolved call arguments have committed expected/actual types but numericCallArgumentMismatch discarded nonnumeric expected types. Reuse functionArgumentCompatible for every committed expected type, preserving generic conflicts and reference/array compatibility. No stdlib signature or source fixture oracle changed.

changes.selfhost/semantic/diagnostics.slg: Validate committed nonnumeric parameters as well as numeric ones. Preserve default readonly reads and slice views; raw numeric/character array parameter context keeps existing element/range checks. Canonical sys.io and sys.runtime print/println use existing displayable-value rules, not their Text facade.
changes.selfhost/llvm/emitter/diagnostics.slg: Direct additional-parameter diagnostics reuse emitSemanticCallPathName for canonical import alias expansion, matching CSharp direct-call names.
changes.selfhost/semantic/type_ids.slg: Match CSharp ArrayLiteralStorageFacts numeric literals: lexer character literals become NumberExpression in CSharp and share immutable literal backing recognition in SLG.

retainedPrerequisiteFailureCauses: Readonly default method receiver must read its underlying type, not be treated as nominal mismatch.
Untyped empty array literal [] has no element to contradict the parameter context; stored/explicit typed arrays are distinct.
Formatter requires multiline conditional continuation indentation; corrected before compiler build.
Readonly growable array input may pass the same declared slice view as its underlying array; preserve mut/move restrictions.
